reports.title: Aramark Reports Earnings Results for Fiscal 2026

guidance.heading: OUTLOOK
section: Aramark currently anticipates its full-year financial performance for fiscal 2027 as follows:

($ in millions, except Adjusted EPS and Leverage Ratio) | Fiscal 2026 Reference Point | Year-over-year Organic Growth1

“Our teams remain focused on delivering for our clients and building on the success throughout the business,” Zillmer added. “With multiple, broad-based growth drivers already underway, I couldn't be more excited about the significant opportunities ahead.”
